title: Level 9.3 - "The Overcast Manifold"
physical_identity: A static, fog-bound countryside: tall wheat fields forming a labyrinth, grassy hills, forests, one warping highway with a mossy brick wall, and wooden houses on hilltops. Overcast dreamscape.
scale_topology: Titanic outdoor Möbius terrain; one continuous folded landscape where forests return to fields; no true outside.
anomalies: Permanent static state, nothing grows or decays
Engine noise approaching but never arriving
lighting_sound: Overcast dim light, high humidity, fog; weak wind; an engine echo always present, never nearer.
items_communities: House interiors with utensils, furnishings, beams

entrances.method: Darkened corner manifests in wheat field and engulfs wanderer
entrances.conditions: Single discovery case while heading toward Level 10
entrances.quote: a darkened corner within the wheat fields manifested, engulfing her

exits.method: Break weak back door of a house
exits.quote: she once again found herself within grassy fields leading to nowhere

signature_mechanic: Static looping foggy landscape with a Möbius fold: no exit, forests loop to fields, and an engine sound that nears but never arrives.
do_not: Let the engine reach the player
conflicts_notes: Prose is literary; survival class blank. Parent link implied by 'subsector of the grand Level 9'. Level 9.2/9.4 are only in the link list.

key_quotes.quote: Roads exist with no cars, but the dreadful echo of engines still pervades.
there is no escape, there is no inhabitant
they eventually lead back to the grassy fields
No life forms exist within Level 9.3
nothing may grow, fade, or break down
a darkened corner within the wheat fields manifested, engulfing her
